purpose: Connect real Trader Lab candidate bindings to a predecision-only multi-timeframe T02 Explorer/Validator laboratory.

timeframes.future_extension: Additional predecision timeframes may enter only when retained native evidence contains them.

m1_binding.causality: Only M1 candles closed at or before decision timestamp may contribute features.

features: D1/H4/H1 body alignment and range state
M5 displacement alignment, efficiency and volatility
M1 last-body alignment, body efficiency, volatility/range ratios, 5m/15m displacement, 60m position, 09:00-10:00 NY reference-range/raid state
explorer.search_policy: Broad TRAIN exploration is permitted; nothing discovered on TRAIN is approved until frozen and evaluated on untouched chronological TEST.

validator.universality_gate: No symbol/trader predicate; M1-only signals from one current lineage may be exploratory but cannot by themselves establish cross-asset universality.
